verdict.rationale: Digits ships an AI assistant (Ask Digits), so letting users attach external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows Digits acting as an MCP server for external tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Ask Digits or any other Digits surface connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
